nodes.label: Input: items, k; sort items by profit desc; init total=0, seen=set(), dups=[], ans=0, idx=0
nodes.action: ctx['items'] = ctx['arg0']; ctx['k'] = ctx['arg1']; ctx['items'] = sorted(ctx['items'], key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True); ctx['total'] = 0; ctx['seen'] = set(); ctx['dups'] = []; ctx['ans'] = 0; ctx['idx'] = 0

nodes.label: Is idx < k? (building the initial top-k selection)
Extract p, c; total += p
nodes.action: ctx['p'] = ctx['items'][ctx['idx']][0]; ctx['c'] = ctx['items'][ctx['idx']][1]; ctx['total'] += ctx['p']

nodes.label: Is dups non-empty and c not in seen? (can exchange for a new category)
nodes.logic: len(ctx['dups']) > 0 and ctx['c'] not in ctx['seen']

nodes.label: Exchange smallest dup profit for p: total += p - dups.pop(); seen.add(c)
cand = total + len(seen)^2; ans = max(ans, cand); idx += 1
nodes.action: ctx['cand'] = ctx['total'] + len(ctx['seen']) * len(ctx['seen']); ctx['ans'] = max(ctx['ans'], ctx['cand']); ctx['idx'] += 1
